files.patch:
@@ -1,35 +0,0 @@
-# frozen_string_literal: true
-
-require_relative "lib/wlex/version"
-
-Gem::Specification.new do |spec|
-  spec.name = "wlex"
-  spec.version = WLex::VERSION
-  spec.authors = ["Werner Stein"]
-  spec.email = ["werner.stein@gmail.com"]
-  spec.summary = "WLex is a lexical analyser construction tool in Ruby."
-  spec.description = <<-DESC
-WLex is a lexical analyser construction tool in Ruby. The goal is to
-stay close to how the original lex tool works and combine it with the
-expressiveness of Ruby.
-  DESC
-  spec.homepage = "https://github.com/wstein/wlex"
-  spec.license = "MIT"
-
-  spec.metadata["allowed_push_host"] = "https://rubygems.org"
-  spec.metadata["bug_tracker_uri"] = "https://github.com/wstein/wlex/issues"
-  spec.metadata["changelog_uri"] = "https://github.com/wstein/wlex/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md"
-  spec.metadata["documentation_uri"] = "https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/wlex"
-  spec.metadata["homepage_uri"] = spec.homepage
-  spec.metadata["rubygems_mfa_required"] = "true"
-  spec.metadata["source_code_uri"] = "https://github.com/wstein/wlex"
-
-  spec.files = Dir["lib/**/*"]
-  spec.extra_rdoc_files = Dir["README.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "LICENSE.txt"]
-  spec.require_paths = ["lib"]
-  spec.required_ruby_version = ">= 2.5.0"
-
-  spec.add_development_dependency "rake"
-  spec.add_development_dependency "logger"
-  spec.add_development_dependency "rspec", ">= 3.0"
-end
